description: The company registry MCP: brreg orgnr, Companies House, Bolagsverket organisationsnummer.
name: io.github.foretak/registry-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Contact address sent in the User-Agent to the national registry, as Brønnøysundregistrene asks of API clients. Unset means an anonymous client, which may be blocked upstream.
environmentVariables.name: REGISTRY_MCP_CONTACT_EMAIL

environmentVariables.description: Path to the local SQLite response cache (24 h TTL). Defaults to ./data/cache.sqlite3.
environmentVariables.name: REGISTRY_MCP_CACHE_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Companies House REST API key, required for the United Kingdom (GB). Free from developer.company-information.service.gov.uk. Unset means GB lookups return an upstream_error naming this variable; every other country still answers.
environmentVariables.name: COMPANIES_HOUSE_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Bolagsverket OAuth 2 client id, required for Sweden (SE) together with BOLAGSVERKET_CLIENT_SECRET. Free, no contract: request both from Bolagsverket's kundanmälan form. Unset means SE lookups return an upstream_error naming both variables; every other country still answers.
environmentVariables.name: BOLAGSVERKET_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: Bolagsverket OAuth 2 client secret, the other half of BOLAGSVERKET_CLIENT_ID. Both are needed before Sweden (SE) can answer.
environmentVariables.name: BOLAGSVERKET_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Which Bolagsverket environment the Swedish credentials belong to: 'production' (default) or 'test'. It selects the data host and the token host as a pair, so the two can never be mixed.
environmentVariables.name: BOLAGSVERKET_ENVIRONMENT

title: registry-mcp — national company registries
